name: Lucas Retrieval
description: Retrieve grounded context from the local Lucas Database Agent Retrieve API.

apiBaseUrl.description: Lucas Database API base URL. Defaults to LUCAS_AGENT_RETRIEVE_BASE_URL, LUCAS_DB_API_BASE_URL, or http://127.0.0.1:8765.

apiToken.description: Optional bearer token if the local Lucas read API is protected in a future deployment.

defaultMaxChunksPerSource.description: Default maximum accepted chunks per source.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for one Lucas retrieval call.
